**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record VendorOption
```

A setting a printer offers beyond the typed options in [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/), such as print quality, stapling or a driver's own settings, with the values it takes.

Each one can be used as it is: set [VendorOption.Key](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/#key) in [PrintOptions.VendorOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#vendoroptions) to one of the [VendorOption.Choices](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/#choices)' values, or to a value the [VendorOption.Kind](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/#kind) allows. For example, an IPP printer may offer `ipp:print-quality` with the choices `3` (Draft), `4` (Normal) and `5` (High).

Vendor options aren't portable: keys start with the print system that reads them (`ipp:` or `windows:`), and their values often only mean something to the printer that listed them. Settings the typed options cover, such as paper size and duplex, aren't listed.

Records compare lists by reference, as [PrinterCapabilities](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/) does.

```csharp
public VendorOption()
```

## Properties

### AllowsSeveralValues

```csharp
public bool AllowsSeveralValues { get; init; }
```

Gets whether a job can set several of the [VendorOption.Choices](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/#choices) at once, separated by commas, as with IPP `finishings` such as `4,5` (staple and punch).

### Choices

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<VendorOptionChoice> Choices { get; init; }
```

Gets the values to choose from, for a [VendorOptionKind.Choice](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroptionkind/#values) option; empty otherwise.

### DefaultValue

```csharp
public string? DefaultValue { get; init; }
```

Gets the value the printer uses when a job doesn't set this option, or `null` if not reported.

### DisplayName

```csharp
public required string DisplayName { get; init; }
```

Gets a name to show people, such as "Print quality". Comes from the printer driver where it has one.

### Key

```csharp
public required string Key { get; init; }
```

Gets the key to set in [PrintOptions.VendorOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#vendoroptions), such as `ipp:print-quality` or `windows:feature:psk:JobStapleAllDocuments`.

### Kind

```csharp
public VendorOptionKind Kind { get; init; }
```

Gets what kind of value the option takes: one of the [VendorOption.Choices](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroption/#choices), a whole number, or text.

### MaximumValue

```csharp
public long? MaximumValue { get; init; }
```

Gets the largest value an [VendorOptionKind.Number](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroptionkind/#values) option takes, or `null` if not reported.

### MinimumValue

```csharp
public long? MinimumValue { get; init; }
```

Gets the smallest value an [VendorOptionKind.Number](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/vendoroptionkind/#values) option takes, or `null` if not reported.
